name: Band Rotational Overhead Press
steps: Stand on the center of a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ends at shoulder height.
Brace your core and drop into a shallow athletic quarter squat.
Drive smoothly up to standing while pressing one hand overhead and rotating your hips and chest toward the opposite side.
Lower your hand back to your shoulder as you return to center, then repeat pressing and rotating to the other side, alternating sides.
tips: Allow your back foot to pivot smoothly with your hips as you rotate.
Keep your ribs controlled and avoid arching your lower back at the top of each press.
